[Section] Conclusion
[source_id=32] In this paper, we presented our ASR system participated in VLSP 2019 challenge that incorporates a language model combination technique to handle conversation speech with small amount of text data required. The method demonstrated that it can help to reduce WER by 3% on the VLSP 2019 challenge.
